resources.purpose: Run one $262.agent realm concurrently for the conformance host
resources.owner: Process-wide agent Group; records are reclaimed by agent.reset
resources.multiplicity: One OS thread per live agent record
resources.admission: No coordinator limit; allocation and OS spawn failure return OutOfMemory
resources.blocking: May park in broadcast, Atomics.wait, or agent sleep
resources.shutdown: agent.reset interrupts waiters and joins every started agent
resources.scratch_memory: Fresh realm plus process-allocator Agent source/report state

resources.purpose: Trace one Context precise heap concurrently with its single mutator
resources.multiplicity: At most one marker per Context
resources.admission: Only when gc_concurrent is enabled and an old collection is due; spawn failure finishes marking synchronously
resources.blocking: CPU tracing loop; synchronizes through heap mark state
resources.shutdown: finishConcurrentGCIfActive signals and joins before cycle completion or Context teardown
resources.scratch_memory: Collector mark work owned and reported by the Context heap

resources.purpose: Run a shared-realm JavaScript Thread entry function
resources.owner: Context ThreadRecord and realm GIL/cooperative-root protocol
resources.multiplicity: One OS thread per live JavaScript Thread
resources.admission: Optional Context max_js_threads cap plus 15-bit thread-id space
resources.blocking: May block in Lock, Condition, Atomics.wait, join, host work, or GC safepoints
resources.shutdown: Thread completion is published once; join/asyncJoin and Context teardown reclaim records
resources.scratch_memory: Per-thread interpreter registration, microtask queue, entry arguments, and native stack

resources.purpose: Run an isolated script Worker realm and message loop
resources.multiplicity: One OS thread and Context per Worker
resources.admission: No coordinator limit; allocation/OS spawn failure returns OutOfMemory
resources.blocking: Parks on inbox, inspector command queue, module/host work, or termination
resources.shutdown: Caller closes or terminates, then joins and destroys the Worker
resources.scratch_memory: Isolated Context, bounded channels, structured-clone buffers, optional inspector state

resources.purpose: Run an isolated module Worker realm, module graph, and message loop
resources.multiplicity: One OS thread and Context per Worker
resources.admission: No coordinator limit; allocation/OS spawn failure returns OutOfMemory
resources.blocking: May block in module host callbacks, inbox, inspector commands, or termination
resources.shutdown: Caller closes or terminates, then joins and destroys the Worker
resources.scratch_memory: Isolated Context, module registry/source copies, bounded channels, optional inspector state

resources.purpose: Raise a private-ABI ContextGroup termination request at its armed deadline
resources.multiplicity: At most one lazily-created watchdog per ContextGroup
resources.admission: Created on first finite time limit; spawn failure leaves synchronous checkpoint enforcement active
resources.blocking: Sleeps in bounded intervals and interrupts engine waiters when a deadline fires
resources.shutdown: ContextGroup destruction sets watchdog_stop and joins the thread
resources.scratch_memory: No dynamic work queue; fixed ContextGroup atomics and native stack

synchronous_subsystems.status: Compilation runs synchronously on the requesting JavaScript/host thread; there is no production compiler helper or queue
Decode, validation, and compilation run synchronously on the requesting JavaScript/host thread; production Wasm creates no helper pool
